sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: I'm here to tell you tonight, we believe we're on track to win this election.
sentences.zh: 今晚我在这里告诉大家，我们坚信我们有望赢得这场选举。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: So we'll be going to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将诉诸美国

sentences.en: Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 最高法院。

sentences.en: We want all voting to stop.
sentences.zh: 我们希望所有投票都停止。

sentences.en: And it ain't over till every vote is counted.
sentences.zh: 在每一张选票被统计完之前，一切还没有结束。

sentences.en: Every ballot is counted.
sentences.zh: 每一张选票都要被统计。

sentences.en: Joe Biden is calling for patience.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登呼吁大家保持耐心。

sentences.en: And President Trump is threatening legal action, as millions of votes are still uncounted.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普总统则威胁要采取法律行动，因为数百万张选票仍未计入。

sentences.en: We don't want them to find any ballots at 4 o'clock in the morning and add them to the liSt.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望他们在凌晨4点找到任何选票并将其加到名单里。

sentences.en: And by the way, it's going to take time to count the votes.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，点票需要时间。

sentences.en: We're going to win Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我们将会赢得宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: Alex Burns on where the election stands and the remaining paths to victory.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·伯恩斯谈论选举现状以及通往胜利的剩余路径。

sentences.en: We were getting ready to win this election.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在准备赢得这场选举。

sentences.en: Frankly, we did win this election.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我们确实赢得了这场选举。

sentences.en: We did win this election.
sentences.zh: 我们确实赢得了这场选举。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, November 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月4日，星期三。

sentences.en: As ballot counting continued overnight, Joe Biden expanded his lead in Arizona
sentences.zh: 随着夜间计票工作的继续，乔·拜登扩大了在亚利桑那州的领先优势，

sentences.en: and took slight leads in two crucial Midwestern states, Wisconsin and Michigan, where mail-in ballots heavily favored him.
sentences.zh: 并在两个关键的中西部州威斯康星州和密歇根州取得了微弱领先，在这两个州，邮寄选票极大地对她或他有利。

sentences.en: In Pennsylvania, Biden has won the counted absentee ballots by an overwhelming margin so far.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州，拜登到目前为止以压倒性优势赢得了已统计的缺席选票。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that if he carries the remaining ballots by a similar margin, he would win the state.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，如果他以相似的优势拿下剩余选票，他将赢得该州。

sentences.en: Alex, you have to unmute yourself.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，你得取消静音。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 喂。

sentences.en: The reflexes are a little slow at this hour.
sentences.zh: 在这个时间，反应有点慢了。

sentences.en: A little bit.
sentences.zh: 有一点。

sentences.en: Well, good morning, Alex.
sentences.zh: 好吧，早安，亚历克斯。

sentences.en: It's some kind of morning.
sentences.zh: 这算是个什么早晨。

sentences.en: Well, it is 1.40 a.m.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在是凌晨1点40分。

sentences.en: in the morning.
sentences.zh: 在清晨。

sentences.en: And a lot of people are going to be listening to this in a few hours when they wake up.
sentences.zh: 而且很多人几个小时后醒来时就会听到这个。

sentences.en: And despite being prepared by you for the real possibility that we would not have a result on election night
sentences.zh: 尽管你让我做好了选举之夜可能不会出结果的真实心理准备，

sentences.en: and that the race would seem inconclusive, I have to say it feels like we're in an even less certain situation than we had anticipated.
sentences.zh: 并且比赛看起来会毫无定论，但我必须说，感觉我们处于比我们预期的更加不确定的境地中。

sentences.en: Does that feel right to you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得是这样吗？

sentences.en: It's certainly a less certain situation than I had anticipated because not only do we not know at this hour who has won the presidential race,
sentences.zh: 这当然比我预期的要不确定得多，因为不仅在这个时候我们不知道谁赢得了总统大选，

sentences.en: but the states that you and I talked about as the early bellwethers to see whether the president's electoral map would hold together,
sentences.zh: 而且你和我谈论过的那些作为早期风向标、用来观察总统选举版图是否能维持的州，

sentences.en: we actually don't have calls in any of them except for Florida at this point, which went for the president.
sentences.zh: 实际上，除了目前支持总统的佛罗里达州之外，我们在其中任何一个州都没有宣布获胜者。

sentences.en: Very good sign for him.
sentences.zh: 对他来说是个非常好的迹象。

sentences.en: We don't have a call in North Carolina, although the president is slightly ahead.
sentences.zh: 我们在北卡罗来纳州还没有宣布结果，尽管总统略微领先。

sentences.en: I don't have a call in Georgia, also slightly ahead there, though it looks like the outstanding ballots are pretty heavily in Democratic areas.
sentences.zh: 我在佐治亚州也没有宣布结果，他在那里也略微领先，尽管看起来未完成的选票很大一部分在民主党选区。

sentences.en: We don't have a call in Arizona, where Joe Biden is ahead by a small but seemingly meaningful margin, you know, with maybe hours to go in that count.
sentences.zh: 我们在亚利桑那州没有宣布结果，乔·拜登以微小但似乎意义重大的优势领先，你知道的，那里的计票可能还要持续几个小时。

sentences.en: And that's before we even get to the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 而这甚至在我们到达中西部之前就已经发生了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, this is a blurrier picture than I think certainly I had expected or hoped to have at almost two in the morning.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这比我认为我肯定期望或希望在凌晨两点左右看到的画面要模糊得多。

sentences.en: You seem displeased.
sentences.zh: 你似乎很不高兴。

sentences.en: Well, it's just, you know, you sort of want some kind of maybe not full clarity.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这只是，你知道的，你多少想要某种也许并非完全清晰的结果。

sentences.en: We knew there was a strong chance that we wouldn't get that.
sentences.zh: 我们知道有很大的可能性不会得到那个结果。

sentences.en: But this is, I think, first of all, a closer election than the polls had indicated.
sentences.zh: 但我想，首先，这是一场比民调显示的更势均力敌的选举。

sentences.en: But even once you get below the level of the polls, a closer election than I think we expected the map to give us at this point in the process.
sentences.zh: 但即使抛开民调水平不谈，这也是一场比我们预期选举版图在这个阶段带给我们的更势均力敌的选举。

sentences.en: Let's drill down into these states that you just mentioned, states that we had expected to be called relatively early in the night.
sentences.zh: 让我们深入探讨你刚才提到的那些州，那些我们预计会在当晚较早时候出结果的州。

sentences.en: Florida, North Carolina, Georgia, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州、北卡罗来纳州、佐治亚州、亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: And let's start with Florida.
sentences.zh: 让我们从佛罗里达州开始。

sentences.en: You have long said the scenario in which a Biden victory would be declared on election night would be a scenario in which he won Florida,
sentences.zh: 你长期以来一直说过，如果拜登要在选举之夜宣布胜利，那将是他赢得佛罗里达州的情景，

sentences.en: a state that was always considered very close.
sentences.zh: 这是一个一直被认为非常胶着的州。

sentences.en: As you said, he did not win Florida.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，他没有赢得佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: The president did.
sentences.zh: 总统赢了。

sentences.en: So what's the story of what happened there in Florida?
sentences.zh: 那么佛罗里达州到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: It's really a pretty extraordinary one that when you look at the counties across the state that we were watching as indicators for where voters in the middle were going,
sentences.zh: 这真的是一个相当非同寻常的现象，当你审视全州我们一直在关注的那些作为中间派选民走向指标的县时，

sentences.en: where independent voters were going.
sentences.zh: 也就是独立选民的走向。

sentences.en: Joe Biden did quite well in those places relative to Hillary Clinton four years ago.
sentences.zh: 相比四年前的希拉里·克林顿，乔·拜登在这些地方表现相当不错。

sentences.en: Places like what?
sentences.zh: 像什么地方？

sentences.en: Places like Hillsborough County, Pinellas County, around the city of Tampa, up around Jacksonville, he did better than Clinton did four years ago.
sentences.zh: 像希尔斯伯勒县、皮内拉斯县、坦帕市周边以及杰克逊维尔周边，他的表现比四年前的克林顿更好。

sentences.en: These are traditionally the places that a Democrat needs to make inroads into Republican-leaning areas in order to win statewide.
sentences.zh: 这些传统上是民主党人为了赢得全州胜利而需要在倾向共和党的地区取得突破的地方。

sentences.en: So based on what I just told you, you would think that Joe Biden had probably won the state.
sentences.zh: 所以根据我刚才告诉你的，你可能会认为乔·拜登可能已经赢得了该州。

sentences.en: Not so, because he really drastically underperformed in Miami-Dade County, which is traditionally the cornerstone of the Democrats' popular vote strategy in Florida.
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此，因为他在迈阿密-戴德县的表现实在太糟糕了，而该县传统上是民主党人在佛罗里达州获得多数选票战略的基石。

sentences.en: So what happened in Miami-Dade?
sentences.zh: 那么迈阿密-戴德县发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, you wouldn't necessarily have anticipated this based on the way he ran his first campaign four years ago.
sentences.zh: 嗯，根据他四年前开展第一次竞选的方式，你未必能预料到这一点。

sentences.en: But the president appears to have gained ground really significantly with Hispanic and Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 但总统似乎在西班牙裔和拉丁裔选民中获得了非常显著的支持。

sentences.en: And it's a distinctive community in South Florida.
sentences.zh: 这是南佛罗里达州一个独特的社群。

sentences.en: It is heavily shaped by the Cuban-American population, which is historically much more conservative than Hispanic voters nationwide.
sentences.zh: 它在很大程度上受到古巴裔美国人人口的影响，这部分人群在历史上比全国范围内的西班牙裔选民要保守得多。

sentences.en: But the president did even better than you expect a Republican to do with Cuban-American voters and with other Hispanic voters in Miami-Dade.
sentences.zh: 但总统在古巴裔美国人以及迈阿密-戴德县的其他西班牙裔选民中，表现甚至比你对一个共和党人的期望还要好。

sentences.en: So Alex, how exactly do you make sense of the way that the Latino and the Cuban-American vote broke in this all-important county?
sentences.zh: 那么，亚利桑那... 噢亚历克斯，拉丁裔和古巴裔选民的选票在这个至关重要的县是如何分布的，你究竟是如何理解的？

sentences.en: What's your sense of what motivated these voters to go with the president in greater numbers?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，是什么激励了这些选民更多地支持总统？

sentences.en: Well, we know that over the last couple of years,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道在过去几年里，

sentences.en: the president has made a really concerted effort to improve his standing in South Florida and with Hispanic voters across the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: 总统做出了真正坚定的努力，以改善他在南佛罗里达州以及整个佛罗里达州西班牙裔选民中的地位。

sentences.en: And he has done it to a great degree by characterizing the Democrats as these left-wing radicals who are in league with socialists and who would turn the country into,
sentences.zh: 他很大程度上通过将民主党人描述为与社会主义者勾结、会把国家变成...的左翼激进分子来实现这一点，

sentences.en: he often doesn't say Cuba, he often says Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 他通常不说古巴，他通常说委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: And there is a significant Venezuelan-American population in South Florida.
sentences.zh: 南佛罗里达州有大量委内瑞拉裔美国人人口。

sentences.en: But there are clearly voters there for whom the rhetoric of socialism that you have heard from some folks in the Democratic Party, not Joe Biden,
sentences.zh: 但显然那里的选民对民主党某些人（不是乔·拜登，

sentences.en: but from other very prominent Democrats, is a real turnoff.
sentences.zh: 而是其他非常著名的民主党人）口中说出的社会主义言论感到真正的反感。

sentences.en: And the president and other Democrats in the state have really used that to their great political advantage.
sentences.zh: 总统和该州的其他民主党人确实利用这一点为他们带来了巨大的政治优势。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: This was a state that President Trump won in 2016 narrowly.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普总统在2016年险胜的一个州。

sentences.en: It was expected to be close.
sentences.zh: 人们预计选情会很胶着。

sentences.en: As of this moment, it remains very close.
sentences.zh: 截至目前，它依然非常胶着。

sentences.en: What can you tell us about what's going on there in North Carolina?
sentences.zh: 关于北卡罗来纳州正在发生的事情，你能告诉我们什么？

sentences.en: Well, it is very, very close in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 嗯，北卡罗来纳州的选情非常非常胶着。

sentences.en: And it does seem like there is some potential for Biden to close the gap somewhat.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来拜登确实有一些潜力缩小差距。

sentences.en: There is trailing by about, I think it's 77,000 votes or so right now.
sentences.zh: 目前落后大约，我想大概是77,000票左右。

sentences.en: So a little less than a point and a half.
sentences.zh: 所以略低于一个半百分点。

sentences.en: Many of the outstanding votes appear to be in Democratic-leaning areas.
sentences.zh: 许多未统计的选票似乎都在倾向民主党的地区。

sentences.en: So that is a state that is likely going to be decided, you know, on the razor's edge one way or another.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个很可能会以微弱优势决出胜负的州。

sentences.en: But, you know, based on what we've seen so far, it looks like the story in North Carolina and the story in many other places is that, you know,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，根据我们目前所看到的，北卡罗来纳州以及许多其他地方的情况似乎是，

sentences.en: Biden did improve upon Democratic performance in the state, in the cities, and especially in suburban areas.
sentences.zh: 拜登确实提升了民主党在该州、在城市特别是郊区地区的表现。

sentences.en: But that President Trump also improved on his performance in more rural areas.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统在更多农村地区的表现也有所提升。

sentences.en: And in a state like North Carolina, you have some big cities.
sentences.zh: 在北卡罗来纳州这样的地方，有一些大城市。

sentences.en: You do not have a dominant big city the way you do in a state like Arizona, Phoenix, and the Phoenix area.
sentences.zh: 但你没有像亚利桑那州的菲尼克斯及其周边地区那样占绝对主导地位的大城市。

sentences.en: Or even next door in Georgia with the Atlanta metro area being such a force in statewide politics.
sentences.zh: 甚至不像隔壁的佐治亚州那样，亚特兰大都会区成为全州政治中的一股巨大力量。

sentences.en: And so if you are the Republican candidate,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你是共和党候选人，

sentences.en: you absolutely can make up for setbacks in the suburbs by running up the scoreboard even further in the less populous areas of the state.
sentences.zh: 你绝对可以通过在全州人口较少的地区进一步扩大比分，来弥补在郊区的挫折。

sentences.en: So as a question of pure math, when it comes to a place like North Carolina, a rising tide of voters, and we know there was historic turnout in this race, in the case of Trump,
sentences.zh: 所以作为一个纯粹的数学问题，当谈到像北卡罗来纳州这样一个选民激增的地方时（我们知道这次选举的投票率创下了历史新高），对特朗普而言，

sentences.en: that means a lot of small gains in a lot of rural counties that just add up and up and up and up and eventually become a victory, potentially.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在许多农村县获得许多微小的增长，这些增长不断累积，最终可能变成一场潜在的胜利。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, we don't know whether that's going to happen in North Carolina when we have all the votes tabulated.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们将所有选票统计完毕后，我们还不知道这是否会在北卡罗来纳州发生。

sentences.en: We do know that has happened in a couple other places.
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道这在其他几个地方发生过。

sentences.en: And this is sort of echo of the 2016 election, right, when I think there was this sense reinforced by public polling and private polling by both parties that at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 这有点像是2016年大选的重演，对吧？当时我认为有一种感觉，得到了两党公开民调和私人民调的强化，即到头来，

sentences.en: there just weren't going to be enough rural voters to make up for the president's or at the time, candidate Trump's unpopularity in more densely populated areas.
sentences.zh: 农村选民根本不够多，无法弥补总统（或者当时作为候选人的特朗普）在人口更稠密地区的不受欢迎程度。

sentences.en: And that obviously turned out not to be the case.
sentences.zh: 而事实证明显然并非如此。

sentences.en: OK, next among this early wave of states is Georgia.
sentences.zh: 好的，在这波早期选票州的名单中接下来是佐治亚州。

sentences.en: And this has been a Republican stronghold.
sentences.zh: 这一直是共和党的堡垒。

sentences.en: Unexpectedly, it entered battleground status this year.
sentences.zh: 出乎意料的是，它今年进入了摇摆州状态。

sentences.en: And so if Biden was able to pull off Georgia, that seemed like it would be a very positive sign for him.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果拜登能够拿下佐治亚州，那对他来说似乎是一个非常积极的信号。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the fact that it is still so close in Georgia is certainly a hopeful sign for Biden,
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州的选情依然如此胶着，对拜登来说无疑是一个充满希望的信号，

sentences.en: that the president is ahead there by about 114,000 votes with the remaining vote really concentrated in metro Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 总统在那里领先约114,000票，而剩余的选票真正集中在亚特兰大都会区。

sentences.en: This is a state where, unfortunately for you and me, there have been some pretty distinctive snafus at the polls.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不幸对你我而言在投票站出现了一些相当独特的混乱状况的州。

sentences.en: A water main break.
sentences.zh: 水管爆裂。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 噢，哇。

sentences.en: In one crucial facility in Fulton County.
sentences.zh: 在富尔顿县的一个关键设施里。

sentences.en: Some difficulties processing ballots in one of the key suburban counties around Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 在亚特兰大周边的某个关键郊区县处理选票时遇到了一些困难。

sentences.en: So we are going to be waiting a little while to find out exactly what the tally is in those places,
sentences.zh: 所以我们要等上一会儿才能弄清楚这些地方的确切票数，

sentences.en: not because actually of any of the sort of structural issues with voting and tabulating ballots in the pandemic, but because of sort of more pedestrian reasons.
sentences.zh: 这其实不是因为在疫情期间投票和点票的任何结构性问题，而是出于更常规的原因。

sentences.en: But what we see there right now is the president certainly holding his own in rural Georgia,
sentences.zh: 但我们现在在那里看到的是，总统在佐治亚州农村地区绝对稳住了阵脚，

sentences.en: Vice President Biden solidly improving on Hillary Clinton's performance in the Atlanta suburbs.
sentences.zh: 副总统拜登在亚特兰大郊区的表现稳步超过了希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: And seemingly, you know, he's not carrying these counties, but in the sort of outer ring ex-urban communities around Atlanta,
sentences.zh: 而且看起来，你知道，他没有拿下这些县，但在亚特兰大周边的外环远郊社区，

sentences.en: he does seem to be holding down the president's margins relative to what he got four years ago.
sentences.zh: 他似乎确实遏制了总统相对于四年前所得票数的优势。

sentences.en: So there's clearly right now a path for Biden in that state, but it is so close.
sentences.zh: 所以目前拜登在该州显然还有一条获胜路径，但选情太胶着了。

sentences.en: And our colleagues at the Upshot estimate that about 10 percent of the vote is yet to be counted, concentrated but not exclusively in Democratic areas.
sentences.zh: 我们《Upshot》栏目的同事估计，大约有10%的选票尚未统计，这些选票集中在但不仅限于民主党地区。

sentences.en: And again, the president's lead right now is a little over 100,000 votes in a state where about four and a half million votes have been cast, 4.6 million votes.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，在一个投票总数约为四百五十万到四百六十万票的州里，总统目前的领先优势略多于10万票。

sentences.en: Finally, in this list is Arizona, and this is another state that has long voted Republican in presidential contests, but also has one of the fastest growing populations.
sentences.zh: 最后在这个名单上的是亚利桑那州，这也是一个在总统大选中长期投票给共和党、但同时也是人口增长最快的州之一。

sentences.en: And Democrats have in many ways been benefiting from the changing demographics there.
sentences.zh: 民主党人在很多方面一直在受益于那里不断变化的人口结构。

sentences.en: Biden appears likely to flip Arizona tonight, right?
sentences.zh: 拜登今晚似乎很有可能拿下亚利桑那州，对吧？

sentences.en: So tell us what we saw there today.
sentences.zh: 所以请给我们讲讲我们今天在那里看到了什么。

sentences.en: You know, the situation in Arizona is not all that different from what we've seen in Georgia,
sentences.zh: 你知道，亚利桑那州的情况与我们在佐治亚州看到的并没有太大不同，

sentences.en: except that we have a sort of a clearer picture of the votes from the big metro area in the state, Phoenix and the big cities around Phoenix.
sentences.zh: 除了我们对该州大型都会区（菲尼克斯以及菲尼克斯周边大城市）的选票有了更清晰的了解。

sentences.en: That we have Biden leading by a little more than six points in the state as of this moment when we're talking now.
sentences.zh: 在我们现在谈话的这个时刻，拜登在该州领先了大约六个百分点以上。

sentences.en: He's up by about 150,000 votes.
sentences.zh: 他领先了大约150,000票。

sentences.en: Now, there's still outstanding ballots to count, and those might lean a little bit more towards President Trump.
sentences.zh: 现在，仍然有未统计的选票，这些选票可能会更倾向于特朗普总统。

sentences.en: But if you look at these states that have come in relatively quickly and in a relatively representative fashion, you know,
sentences.zh: 但如果你看看这些相对较快且以相对具有代表性的方式出结果的州，你知道的，

sentences.en: without sort of early votes or Election Day votes drastically overrepresented, this is certainly the most encouraging one for Biden.
sentences.zh: 如果不算那种早期投票或选举日投票被过度代表的情况，这绝对是对拜登最鼓舞人心的一次。

sentences.en: This is a place where, as you say, the growing and changing population has benefited Democrats up and down the ballot.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这里的选民群体不断增长和变化，这让民主党人在大选中的各个层面上都受益匪浅。

sentences.en: We saw them win a crucial Senate race there in 2018.
sentences.zh: 我们看到他们在2018年赢下了一场至关重要的参议院竞选。

sentences.en: And because of Joe Biden's strength, not just with the fastest growing parts of Arizona's population, but also with older voters, there are a lot of retirees in that state,
sentences.zh: 由于乔·拜登不仅在亚利桑那州增长最快的选民群体中表现强劲，而且在老年选民中也很有优势，该州有大量的退休人员，

sentences.en: that Biden's improvement on Democrats' traditional margins with voters over 65 clearly opened a path there that Hillary Clinton didn't have four years ago.
sentences.zh: 拜登在65岁以上选民中延续了民主党传统的优势比例，这明显为他开辟了一条四年前希拉里·克林顿不曾拥有的道路。

sentences.en: You could almost think of Arizona as looking a little bit like Florida, but without Miami-Dade in the picture,
sentences.zh: 你几乎可以把亚利桑那州看作有点像佛罗里达州，只是没有迈阿密-戴德县在其中，

sentences.en: that those moderate suburbs that we were talking about outside of Tampa, outside of Jacksonville, there are communities in Arizona that look somewhat like those, except, of course,
sentences.zh: 就像我们之前讨论的坦帕和杰克逊维尔市郊那些温和的郊区一样，亚利桑那州也有一些社区与之有些相似，当然除了，

sentences.en: they're in the desert instead of on the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 它们在沙漠里，而不是在海岸边。

sentences.en: And Biden has managed to put together what looks right now like a relatively formidable coalition there.
sentences.zh: 而拜登设法在那里拼凑出了一个目前看来相对强大的联盟。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So let's talk about everywhere else.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈其他地方。

sentences.en: For months, you have been telling us that both Joe Biden and President Trump have multiple paths to victory.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，你一直告诉我们，乔·拜登和特朗普总统都有通往胜利的多条道路。

sentences.en: Biden just has more of them.
sentences.zh: 只是拜登的选择更多。

sentences.en: Do we find ourselves now in a moment where Joe Biden's paths have also become narrower and more limited?
sentences.zh: 我们现在是否发现自己正处于这样一个时刻：乔·拜登的道路也变得更加狭窄和有限？

sentences.en: Yes, we do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们确实处于这样的时刻。

sentences.en: I think you'd still rather be Joe Biden than President Trump right now.
sentences.zh: 我想你现在还是更愿意做乔·拜登，而不是特朗普总统。

sentences.en: But you'd rather be Joe Biden two days ago than Joe Biden tonight in terms of just how broad a path he appears to have to the presidency.
sentences.zh: 但就他似乎拥有的通往总统宝座的道路有多宽广而言，你宁愿自己是两天前的乔·拜登，而不是今晚的乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Both of these candidates need a breakthrough in the upper MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 这两位候选人都需要在中西部北部取得突破。

sentences.en: And that is a pretty familiar place for us to find ourselves in at this point in a narrowly drawn election night.
sentences.zh: 在一个选情胶着的选举之夜的这个阶段，这对于我们来说是一个相当熟悉的情形。

sentences.en: And when you say upper Midwest, you are referring to?
sentences.zh: 当你提到中西部北部时，你指的是哪些地方？

sentences.en: Well, starting with Wisconsin and stretching over to, I guess, technically not the upper Midwest, but Pennsylvania,
sentences.zh: 嗯，从威斯康星州开始，一直延伸到——我想严格来说不算中西部北部，但包括宾夕法尼亚州——

sentences.en: those blue wall states that Hillary Clinton was counting on to winner the presidency four years ago.
sentences.zh: 也就是四年前希拉里·克林顿指望赢得总统宝座的那些“蓝墙”州。

sentences.en: But we just continue to have a really incomplete picture of what's going on there.
sentences.zh: 但我们对那里正在发生的事情仍然只有一个非常不完整的了解。

sentences.en: So, Alex, let's talk about what has to happen in those states for Biden to have a path to victory.
sentences.zh: 所以，亚历克斯，我们来谈谈为了让拜登有通往胜利的道路，这些州必须发生什么。

sentences.en: Well, if we just stipulate for now that each candidate wins the states where he is currently leading in the South and Southwest,
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果我们现在暂且假定每位候选人都赢得了他目前在南部和西南部领先的州，

sentences.en: that's President Trump narrowly holding on to North Carolina and Georgia,
sentences.zh: 也就是特朗普总统险胜北卡罗来纳州和佐治亚州，

sentences.en: Joe Biden narrowly holding on to Arizona and Nevada.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登险胜亚利桑那州和内华达州。

sentences.en: Then our attention shifts to the North, to that string of states, Wisconsin, Michigan, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 那么我们的注意力就转向北方，转向那一连串的州：威斯康星州、密歇根州、宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: And you now have both candidates within striking distance of 270.
sentences.zh: 现在两位候选人都已经进入了距离270票咫尺之遥的范围。

sentences.en: And if either of them wins two of those states, the election is over.
sentences.zh: 如果他们其中任何一人赢得了其中两个州，选举就结束了。

sentences.en: They have almost certainly at that point won 270 electoral college votes.
sentences.zh: 届时他们几乎可以肯定已经赢得了270张选举人票。

sentences.en: In that scenario, if the president wins just Pennsylvania or just Michigan, he hits 270.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，如果总统仅仅赢得了宾夕法尼亚州或仅仅赢得了密歇根州，他就达到了270票。

sentences.en: He cannot win just by picking up a Wisconsin and adding it to the map that I just described.
sentences.zh: 他不能仅仅通过拿下威斯康星州并将其加入我刚才描述的版图中来赢得大选。

sentences.en: So you are in a pretty deadlocked situation until we get clarity in either Pennsylvania or all three of those states
sentences.zh: 所以，在我们对宾夕法尼亚州或这三个州中的任何一个获得明确结果之前，你们处于一个相当僵持的局面，

sentences.en: that you're looking at a really potentially quite narrow margin in the electoral college.
sentences.zh: 你们正在关注一个在选举人票上可能非常非常微弱的优势。

sentences.en: And the reason why we don't yet have results in those three states, Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, and Michigan,
sentences.zh: 我们之所以还没有这三个州——威斯康星州、宾夕法尼亚州和密歇根州——的选举结果，

sentences.en: correct me if I'm wrong, is that they are quite slow to count mail-in ballots, of which there are many in all three.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，是因为它们清点邮寄选票的速度相当慢，而这三个州都有大量的邮寄选票。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in especially the state of Pennsylvania, they're literally not legally allowed to count votes before Election Day,
sentences.zh: 特别是宾夕法尼亚州，法律明文规定他们甚至不被允许在选举日之前清点选票，

sentences.en: even if those votes have been cast weeks in advance through mail-in voting.
sentences.zh: 即使这些选票是通过几周前就开始的邮寄投票提前投出的。

sentences.en: So we are getting a pretty fragmentary picture of these states.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们对这些州的了解相当零碎。

sentences.en: If you look at them on our map right now, the president is leading in all of them.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在看我们地图上的它们，总统在所有这些州都领先。

sentences.en: But that is at least in part because those states are counting Election Day votes first, and Republicans are expected to win the vote on Election Day.
sentences.zh: 但这至少部分是因为这些州首先清点的是选举日当天投出的选票，而外界原本预计共和党人会在选举日投票中获胜。

sentences.en: You have millions of outstanding ballots, especially in Michigan and Pennsylvania, that are expected to lean to Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 你们有数百万张尚未统计的选票，特别是在密歇根州和宾夕法尼亚州，预计这些选票会倾向于乔·拜登。

sentences.en: We just don't know exactly how many, and we don't know exactly by how much they will lean to him
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道具体有多少张，也不知道它们倾向于他的程度会有多大，

sentences.en: and whether when they are all counted, it will be enough to overcome the lead that the president currently has because of Election Day votes.
sentences.zh: 以及当所有选票清点完毕后，是否足以克服总统目前因选举日投票而拥有的领先优势。

sentences.en: By the way, Alex, can we talk for a moment about the polling in a place like Wisconsin?
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，亚历克斯，我们能花点时间聊聊像威斯康星州这样的地方的民调吗？

sentences.en: I feel like I have to hold somebody accountable for that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我得找个人来为那件事负责。

sentences.en: The last Times-Siena College poll showed Joe Biden up 11 points in Wisconsin, and we don't know the results yet for Wisconsin, but it's looking very close.
sentences.zh: 《时报》与锡耶纳学院的最后一次民调显示乔·拜登在威斯康星州领先11个百分点，我们虽然还没有威斯康星州的最终结果，但看起来非常接近。

sentences.en: It's not looking like anything close to an 11-point spread.
sentences.zh: 这看起来一点也不像有11个百分点的差距。

sentences.en: So what do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 对此你怎么看？

sentences.en: I know you're not responsible for the contents of all polls, but what do you think?
sentences.zh: 我知道你并不对所有民调的内容负责，但你是怎么想的？

sentences.en: Well, I appreciate you saying I'm not responsible for the contents of the polls.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢你说我不用对民调内容负责。

sentences.en: I'm not a pollster, but I do have my byline on a lot of stories where we wrote up that polling information.
sentences.zh: 我不是民调专家，但我确实在很多刊登了这些民调信息的报道上署了名。

sentences.en: That's what I was getting at.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的意思。

sentences.en: It is really bracing to look at the results we have tonight and see that in many cases, certainly in Wisconsin, as you say, they do not line up with what our polls predicted.
sentences.zh: 今晚看到这些结果确实让人大跌眼镜，正如你所说，在很多情况下，当然是在威斯康星州，它们与我们民调预测的结果并不相符。

sentences.en: The same is true in Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州也是如此。

sentences.en: We will see about Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待亚利桑那州的情况。

sentences.en: That may hold up better there.
sentences.zh: 那里可能表现得更好一些。

sentences.en: We will see about Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待宾夕法尼亚州的情况。

sentences.en: But yeah, clearly the president had a reservoir of support in Wisconsin that our polls missed.
sentences.zh: 但没错，很显然总统在威斯康星州拥有一批我们的民调没有捕捉到的支持基础。

sentences.en: And this is a place where I think it behooves those of us in the media who have our own public polling to, in some cases, listen to the campaigns, because the campaigns, they can
sentences.zh: 我认为在这个地方，我们这些拥有自己公开民调的媒体理应在某些情况下听取竞选团队的意见，因为竞选团队，他们会

sentences.en: spin you and they can claim that their numbers are different than they are.
sentences.zh: 对你进行舆论包装，并声称他们的数字与实际不同。

sentences.en: But both sides of this race, not just the Trump side, also the Biden side, said pretty insistently
sentences.zh: 但这场竞选的双方，不仅仅是特朗普阵营，还有拜登阵营，都相当坚持地表示，

sentences.en: that they did not have the kind of blowout leads that were showing up in some of the media polling.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有媒体某些民调中显示的那种压倒性的领先优势。

sentences.en: And I suspect that an 11 point margin in Wisconsin would fall into that category.
sentences.zh: 我猜威斯康星州11个百分点的优势大概就属于那种情况。

sentences.en: At this point, Alex, does President Trump actually have more paths to victory than Joe
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，亚历克斯，特朗普总统的通往胜利的道路是不是真的比乔·

sentences.en: Biden?
sentences.zh: 拜登还要多？

sentences.en: It's sort of an unanswerable question.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是一个无法回答的问题。

sentences.en: You know, my inclination is to think not because of what we expect to happen in those northern states where there's still just this fog of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的倾向是认为并没有，因为考虑到我们预计在那些北方州将会发生的事情，那里仍然弥漫着不确定性的迷雾。

sentences.en: And I think that when you look particularly at Wisconsin and Michigan, those states are quite close to Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 我认为，当你特别审视威斯康星州和密歇根州时，这些州与明尼苏达州非常接近。

sentences.en: And that is a state that Hillary Clinton won four years ago by a tiny, tiny margin.
sentences.zh: 而那是希拉里·克林顿在四年前以微乎其微的优势赢下的一个州。

sentences.en: And that Joe Biden is winning more comfortably as we speak.
sentences.zh: 正如我们正在交谈时所看到的，乔·拜登正以更舒适的优势赢得该州。

sentences.en: That's a state that the president targeted because he came so close last time and felt, you know, I can get that last point and a half out of Minnesota if I really make a push for
sentences.zh: 那是总统的目标州，因为他上次距胜利只有一步之遥，并且觉得，你知道的，如果我真的加把劲，就能从明尼苏达州榨取出最后百分之一点五的选票，

sentences.en: it.
sentences.zh: 去争取它。

sentences.en: That didn't happen for him.
sentences.zh: 但那并没有为他发生。

sentences.en: So if you look at what happened in Minnesota and sort of apply it to other states in the upper Midwest that are very similar to it, that's a pretty encouraging picture for Joe
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你看看明尼苏达州发生了什么，并把它套用到中西部北部与它非常相似的其他州，这对乔·

sentences.en: Biden.
sentences.zh: 拜登来说是一个相当鼓舞人心的画面。

sentences.en: But on the other side of this, if you look at a state like Ohio, where the president won by a wide margin four years ago in a more fractured race, he is winning by much the same
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，如果你看看像俄亥俄州这样的州，总统四年前在选情更加碎片化的竞选中以较大优势获胜，他现在在一个选情没那么碎片化的竞选中正以大致相同的

sentences.en: margin right now in a less fractured race.
sentences.zh: 优势获胜。

sentences.en: And that margin will probably come down as the remaining votes, which are in more Democratic areas, come in.
sentences.zh: 随着属于更倾向民主党地区的剩余选票陆续统计进来，这个优势可能会缩小。

sentences.en: But in Ohio, if it's a proxy for parts of Pennsylvania, you know, that also might be encouraging to the president.
sentences.zh: 但在俄亥俄州，如果它是宾夕法尼亚州部分地区的风向标，你知道的，这可能也会让总统感到鼓舞。

sentences.en: So I'm kind of talking around your question.
sentences.zh: 所以我有点在绕着你的问题说。

sentences.en: I think it's not quite answerable.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个问题很难给出确切答案。

sentences.en: Who, you know, who has more paths right now?
sentences.zh: 究竟谁，你知道的，现在拥有更多通往胜利的道路？

sentences.en: I do believe that it is still Biden, but not by as much as we expected it to be.
sentences.zh: 我仍然相信是拜登，只是优势没有我们预期的那么大。

sentences.en: — Alex, you had told us that the fate of the presidency and the Senate are closely intertwined, that it would be likely that the fortunes of Democratic candidates challenging
sentences.zh: ——亚历克斯，你曾告诉我们，总统宝座和参议院的命运紧密相连，那些挑战共和党现任参议员的民主党候选人的命运，很可能与乔·拜登的命运捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: Republican incumbents for Senate seats would be tied to the fortunes of Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 因此，鉴于总统竞选充满不确定性，参议院竞选现在情况如何？

sentences.en: So given the uncertain nature of the presidential race, where do things stand in the Senate races?
sentences.zh: ——嗯，我认为对参议院竞选中的民主党人来说，这是一个令人失望的夜晚。

sentences.en: — Well, I think it's a disappointing night for Democrats in the Senate races.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在这一点上可以比在总统竞选上做出更确切的判断。

sentences.en: I think we can be more definitive about that than in the presidential race.
sentences.zh: 这并不是因为参议院竞选和总统竞选之间出现了某种意料之外的巨大分歧，而是因为乔·拜登在红州的表现没有达到民主党人的预期，而这些红州正包含着一堆作为目标的参议院议席。

sentences.en: And it's not because there is a sort of unanticipated wild divergence between Senate races and the
sentences.zh: 这些地方包括艾奥瓦州、堪萨斯州、蒙大拿州、南卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: presidential race, but because Joe Biden did not do as well as Democrats needed him to in the red states that had a bunch of the targeted Senate seats on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 除了艾奥瓦州之外，这些都是没有人认为拜登能够拿下的州。

sentences.en: These are places like Iowa, Kansas, Montana, South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 但如果他只是以微弱劣势落败，人们曾有一种感觉，即民主党参议员候选人或许可以凭一己之力弥补最后的三四个百分点。

sentences.en: These are states that, with the exception of Iowa, nobody ever thought Biden could carry them.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有看到这种情况在这些州发生。

sentences.en: But if he lost them by a modest amount, that there was a sense that maybe Democratic Senate candidates could, you know, make up the last three or four points on their own.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，参议院的多数党地位尚未尘埃落定，共和党人还未能稳操胜券。

sentences.en: We've not seen that happen in those states.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我刚才绕着回答了你关于在总统竞选中更愿意做谁的问题，暂且认为是乔·拜登。

sentences.en: So, you know, Senate majority has not been firmly decided for the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 而在参议院层面，你现在绝对更愿意做共和党人。

sentences.en: But, you know, I sort of talked around your question about who you'd rather be in the presidential race than, you know, tentatively, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: ——嗯哼。

sentences.en: And on the Senate level, you'd certainly rather be the Republicans right now.
sentences.zh: 那么最后，亚历克斯，几个小时前，乔·拜登发表了一场演讲，听起来非常意气风发，并表示他相信自己有望获胜。

sentences.en: — Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 就在刚刚，特朗普总统也发表了一场演讲，听起来同样非常得意。

sentences.en: So finally, Alex, a couple of hours ago, Joe Biden came out and gave a speech where he sounded quite triumphant and said he believed he was on track to win.
sentences.zh: 他声称就他而言他已经赢了，并表示他希望要求联邦法院停止清点选票，因为在他看来，比赛已经结束了。

sentences.en: And just now, President Trump came out and gave a speech where he sounded very triumphant.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里见证了什么？

sentences.en: He said that as far as he was concerned, he had won and said he wanted to ask federal courts to stop vote counting because in his mind, the race is over.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，这是总统极其不负责任的行为，他在选举之夜的讲话中对竞选现状所作出的声称，无论是全国层面

sentences.en: What are we witnessing here?
sentences.zh: 还是在特定州，完全都是虚假的。

sentences.en: — Well, this is a totally irresponsible act by the president, and the claims that he made in his remarks on election night about the state of the race, both at the national level
sentences.zh: 他声称自己已经赢下了北卡罗来纳州和佐治亚州。

sentences.en: and in specific states, were just totally false.
sentences.zh: 这不是真的。

sentences.en: And he said he's already won North Carolina and Georgia.
sentences.zh: 他说民主党人试图通过继续清点选票来剥夺他选民的投票权。

sentences.en: Not true.
sentences.zh: 这也是假的。

sentences.en: He said that what Democrats are trying to do by continuing to count ballots is disenfranchising his voters.
sentences.zh: ——正如你所说，我们从乔·拜登那里听到的是一场充满自信的演讲，但并没有那种，你知道的，先发制人宣称胜利的企图。

sentences.en: That's not true.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，其核心信息是必须统计所有选票。

sentences.en: — What we heard from Joe Biden was, as you say, I think a confidence speech, but not that kind of, you know, preemptive attempt to claim victory.
sentences.zh: 我认为这显然是正确的。

sentences.en: And, you know, the message was you've got to count all the votes.
sentences.zh: 在宣布获胜之前，你确实必须清点这些州的所有选票。

sentences.en: And I think that's something that is clearly true.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为，相比拜登此前预期的更加岌岌可危的局势，这只是一种不同类型的乐观舆论包装。

sentences.en: You do have to count all the votes in these states before you call a winner.
sentences.zh: 我不会把它和总统的行为混为一谈，总统的行为完全是一种极其不负责任的鲁莽举动。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's a different kind of optimistic spin to put on, I think, a more precarious situation than Biden anticipated at this point.
sentences.zh: ——但亚历克斯，总统这样做的目的是什么？

sentences.en: I wouldn't put it on par with what the president did, which was just an act of real drastic irresponsibility.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，其目的是破坏公众对今年依规设立的选举程序的信任。

sentences.en: — But Alex, what is that intended to accomplish from the president?
sentences.zh: 其目的也是为了让乔·拜登在最终结果确实如此的情况下，更难宣称自己取得了胜利，哪怕这一胜利是合法赢得的。

sentences.en: — Well, it's intended to undermine public faith in the electoral process as it was set up to take place this year.
sentences.zh: 我认为怎么强调现在在任总统攻击民主进程这一行为是多么轻率和危险都不为过，

sentences.en: And it is intended to make it harder for Joe Biden to claim victory if that is ultimately what happens, even if that victory is legitimately won.
sentences.zh: 这种行为公然对合法投出的选票的合法性播下怀疑的种子，而在我们所处的环境中，众所周知有那么多的国内和国外势力，

sentences.en: And I think it can't be overstated what a reckless and dangerous thing it is for a sitting
sentences.zh: 急于在国家内部煽动分歧，甚至鼓励公民骚乱。

sentences.en: president to do to attack the democratic process in this way, to aggressively sow doubt about
sentences.zh: 而总统却没有采取任何措施来阻止这种行为。

sentences.en: the legitimacy of votes that were legally cast in an environment where we know there are so many actors, foreign and domestic, that are so eager to stoke divisions in the country
sentences.zh: ——那么亚历克斯，当你在几个小时后的周三早晨醒来时，你打算关注什么？

sentences.en: and even encourage civil unreSt.
sentences.zh: 人们在这个时候又应该期待什么？

sentences.en: And the president is not doing anything to discourage that.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，我还要过一会儿才会去睡觉，因为我们正期待着威斯康星州、亚利桑那州和内华达州传来更多选票结果。

sentences.en: — So Alex, what are you going to be looking for and at when you wake up in a few hours on Wednesday morning?
sentences.zh: 那可能会真正让我们眼前的局势变得清晰。

sentences.en: And what should people be expecting at this point?
sentences.zh: 但听着，我认为在整个周三，我们将密切关注那些中西部州。

sentences.en: — Well, it's going to be a little while before I go to sleep because we are expecting more votes out of Wisconsin and Arizona and Nevada.
sentences.zh: 我们将密切关注亚特兰大都会区。

sentences.en: And that could really sharpen the picture that we've got.
sentences.zh: 因为如果拜登在佐治亚州反超领先，那么我们之前讨论过的许多票数计算对他来说就会变得容易得多。

sentences.en: But look, I think all through Wednesday, we are going to be watching those Midwestern states very closely.
sentences.zh: 我们只有等到亚特兰大市及其郊区完全报告了结果，才能知道这是否会发生。

sentences.en: We're going to be watching the Atlanta metro area very closely.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我将关注总统的行为举止，以及共和党其他成员如何应对他如此赤裸裸地试图破坏民主程序和平进行的现实。

sentences.en: Because if Biden edges ahead in Georgia, then a lot of the math we talked about gets a lot easier for him.
sentences.zh: ——好吧，我们可能会在5点59分再次与你连线。

sentences.en: We just won't know whether that's going to happen until the city of Atlanta and its suburbs have fully reported.
sentences.zh: ——好的。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm going to be watching the way the president conducts himself and the way the rest of the Republican Party deals with the fact that he is so brazenly trying
sentences.zh: ——就在我们节目结束之前。

sentences.en: to disrupt the peaceful carrying out of the democratic process.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，非常感谢你，祝你剩下的早晨过得愉快。

sentences.en: — Well, we will check back in with you maybe at 5.59.
sentences.zh: ——非常感谢。

sentences.en: — OK.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: — Right before we go out.
sentences.zh: ——这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: Alex, thank you, as always, and have a good rest of your morning.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，一如既往地谢谢你，祝你接下来的一上午过得愉快。

sentences.en: — Thanks a lot.
sentences.zh: — 非常感谢。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: — That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: — 《每日新闻》就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: — For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 数十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·凯尼格将带您了解那些试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 都市。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
